title: The Zscaler MCP server's ZMS tools: inventory, customer ID and known defects

prose.text: The MCP server wraps the Python SDK's ZMS queries as tools. Toolset selection and entitlement filtering are shared with other products: [[shared.mcp-server.tool-inventory]].

prose.label: Defects.

checks.do: Whether ZSCALER_CUSTOMER_ID is set in the MCP server environment when ZMS tools fail.
For an app catalog call that errors, whether it passed a name or category filter.

tool-count.statement: The MCP server registers 20 ZMS tools in one `zms` toolset across nine domains, all read-only.

quotes: All ZMS tools are **read-only** (queries only — no mutations).

customer-id-env.statement: ZMS tools take the tenant ID from `ZSCALER_CUSTOMER_ID` in the server environment: `require_customer_id` reads it and, when it is missing, raises an error naming that variable.

quotes: ``ZSCALER_CUSTOMER_ID``. :func:`require_customer_id` reads it from the environment and raises a clear error if it is missing
ZSCALER_CUSTOMER_ID is required for ZMS tools.
Every query requires `ZSCALER_CUSTOMER_ID`, automatically resolved from the environment.

app-catalog-import.statement: The app catalog tool builds its name and category filter by importing `AppCatalogFilter` from `zscaler.zms.models.inputs`, and the import runs only when a name or category is given; the class that SDK module defines for app catalog filters is `AppCatalogQueryFilter`.

quotes: if not any([name, category]): return None
class AppCatalogQueryFilter: """ Filter for app catalog queries.

app-catalog-filter-fails.statement: A `zms_list_app_catalog` call with a name or category filter fails with an import error before any request is sent; an unfiltered call works.
app-catalog-filter-fails.conditions: Follows from app-catalog-import and a search of the SDK tree at the pin finding no AppCatalogFilter class; not observed on a running server.

customer-id-not-argument.statement: Every ZMS tool calls `require_customer_id` for the tenant ID, and none takes the ID as a tool argument.
customer-id-not-argument.conditions: Rests on a search of src/zscaler_mcp/tools/zms at the pin: each of the 20 tool functions sets customer_id from require_customer_id(), and no input model declares a customer_id field.
